items.title: Lockheed Martin Stock (LMT) Looks Attractive Despite the Budget Debate
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (LMT) stock looks attractive to me despite uncertainty over next year’s defense budget, because its existing contracts provide strong revenue visibility. The aerospace and defense contractor holds a record $292 billion backlog. CEO Jim Taiclet said the F-35 framework “strengthens the way we can plan and invest in the F-35 enterprise.” Investors are questioning next year’s Pentagon spending, but production ramps are already underway.
